blocks.text: VSEPR model molecules ki shaklon ka andaza aur wazahat deta hai magar bonds banne ki wajah nahi batata. Valence bond theory bonds ke banne aur molecules ki shaklon dono se taalluq rakhti hai. Covalent bond bayan karne ka yeh tareeqa molecule ko atoms ka majmooa samajhta hai.

items: Covalent bond tab banta hai jab milti-julti energy wale do atoms ke valence shells ke aadhe bhare orbitals overlap (ek doosre par charhna) karte hain.
Orbitals ka zyada overlap mazboot bond deta hai.
Covalent bonds simti (directional) hain: bond ki simt overlap karne wale orbitals ki shakal aur tareeqe se tai hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: VBT VSEPR mein kya jorti hai, aur do orbitals ke bond banane se pehle kya sach hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: VSEPR sirf shaklon ka andaza deta hai; VBT batati hai ke bonds kyun bante hain aur shaklein bhi. Bond ke liye har atom ek aadha bhara valence orbital laye, dono orbitals milti-julti energy ke hon, aur woh overlap karein; jitna zyada overlap utna mazboot bond, aur overlap ki simt bond ki simt tai karti hai.

items: VBT bond banne aur shakal dono samjhati hai: covalent bond milti-julti energy ke aadhe bhare valence orbitals ka overlap hai; zyada overlap yani mazboot bond; bonds simti hain.
